title: Published values for the worked example in Erkan & Radev (2004)
source: Erkan, G. and Radev, D. R. (2004). LexRank: Graph-based Lexical Centrality as Salience in Text Summarization. JAIR 22:457-479 (arXiv:1109.2128). Figure 1, Table 1 and Table 2, for a subset of DUC 2004 cluster d1003t.
notice: Numeric tables only, transcribed from the paper so the implementation can be checked against its published results. The underlying sentence text is not redistributed here; see Figure 1 of the paper.
reproduction_notes: Table 2 was computed with 0.85 as the probability of following an edge, i.e. the paper's own d in Equation 8 is 0.15. Taking d = 0.85 literally gives values off by more than 0.5.

Figure 1 is printed rounded to two decimals, so Table 1 and Table 2 cannot be reproduced exactly from it. At threshold 0.2 three cells print as 0.20 while their true values straddle the threshold: pairs (d3s2, d5s2) and (d4s1, d5s2) are above it, pair (d3s1, d5s1) is below. Thresholds 0.1 and 0.3 are unaffected.
Algorithm 3 binarises with a strict > comparison, and self links are counted, which is what reproduces Table 1 at thresholds 0.1 and 0.3.
